protocol.definitive: interleaved-7: baseline and branch DSPs co-loaded in ONE process (two vm realms), compute() alternating base/branch per repetition, 7 reps, median; light and rich
protocol.firstPass: separate processes per variant, 5-rep median after one warm call; kept beside the definitive figures. It read +1798 ms (+27 %) on the O2Ring LIGHT leg while the RICH leg of the same input read +131 ms (+2 %) — an asymmetry the block’s construction (two small objects) cannot produce, so the instrument (order/GC effects on a 128 MB text input in a fresh process) was refined, not the band. Peak RSS and export bytes come from this pass (per-process quantities).
